title: Six Days of Texan Charm, Theaters and Parks in Dallas
summary: A week-long journey that weaves between cultural landmarks, scenic parks, and historic sites, giving you a taste of Dallas' unique blend of Southern hospitality and urban flair.
destination: Dallas, Dallas County, Texas, United States

highlights.name: Plano Children's Theater
highlights.why_cant_skip: The intimate setting and talented young performers make for a truly unforgettable experience, with productions that will leave you and your partner beaming with delight.

highlights.name: North Texas Masonic Historical Museum & Library
highlights.why_cant_skip: The vast collection of Masonic artifacts and texts offers a fascinating glimpse into the region's history and the secretive world of Freemasonry, making for a captivating visit.

highlights.name: Robinson Fine Arts Center
highlights.why_cant_skip: The stunning architecture and diverse exhibitions make this a must-visit destination for art lovers, with a rotating selection of works that showcase the best of local and national talent.

accommodation.name: Residence Inn
accommodation.reason: The Residence Inn provides a comfortable and convenient base for exploring Dallas, with its spacious suites and amenities catering perfectly to couples looking for a relaxing stay.

budget.notes: Dallas has a relatively low cost of living, but parking fees and tips can add up; be sure to factor these into your budget to avoid any surprises.

days.rain_plan: If it rains: consider visiting the Plano Children's Theater earlier, as it's mostly indoors
